info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update External Agency By Param1-spec
info.description: The External Agency Management API facilitates the modification of external agency information within the banking ecosystem. It supports updates based on specific parameters, allowing users to tailor agency details to meet changing requirements. Common use cases include managing administrative aspects of information service providers, which are vital for compliance and operational efficiency. This API is particularly useful for financial institutions that need to maintain accurate records of their external partners.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific information provider administration resource identified by RES-100045. It enables modifications to various attributes associated with the resource, ensuring that the data remains accurate and up to date.

requestBody.description: This request body allows for the partial update of the resource identified by RES-100045 in the External Agency Information Provider Administration system. The payload should adhere to the defined schema and may include any combination of properties that the user wishes to modify.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the resource was updated.
